[b][] "Look Behind You, And Remember You Are Only A Man" [] Vashun, Provincia Vashundar, Varkadun. [] [/b]

[i]Varkadi soldiers march in formation down the Via Triumphalis, carrying the banners and standards of the many Legions that serve in the Varkadi Army. Behind them follow open-roofed trucks carrying mountains of equipment and supplies captured from enemies long past, defeated in glorious battles and brutal campaigns. Next came an open-topped car surrounded by various Centurions and War-Sages, in which stood a man in khaki military uniform with a red sash, waving to a crowd that erupted in cheers which could be heard in the heavens. That man was Varian Marzath, Legatus-Maximus of all Varkadi Legions, now being given the immense honor of a Triumph following a life of military campaigns across the Western Hemisphere in the service of Zor-Vezar Tarun and the Threefold Trial of Strength, Honor, and Purpose.

The massive procession of soldiers stops at the Hall of Triumph, where Varian gives an invocation to the Ancestors of Iron, burning incense of black cedar and ironwood and calling upon the spirits of great warriors of the past to bear witness to his achievements. He then kneels before the High War-Sage who places the honored Crown of the Ironfangs upon his head, a wreath of iron adorned with crimson ribbons, before pledging his continued loyalty to Varkadun and it's people. He is finally bestowed by the ceremonial Eternal Blade of Vashundar, granting him the ancient title of Warden of the Ironfang and a voice on the ruling Council of Honor.

A feast follows, attended by all of Varian's legions, their families, and honored guests. Songs of valor are sung, food and drink is in abundance, and War-Sages recite poems and epics of campaigns centuries past. The night ends with a ritual Dance of Blades in the Colosseum by the elite Vasharak Guard to the amusement and cheers of all in attendance. Thus, a statue is erected of Varian in the Hall of Honor, containing the statues of all great legends and heroes Varkadun since the ancient times of our barbaric ancestors. Varkadun stands as a beacon of strength and freedom to the world, embodying the Threefold Trial of Strength, Honor, and Purpose that guides all great soldiers in the past, present, and glorious future![/i]
